rows.label: Flat STR
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: STR %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: FINAL_DAMAGE % (multiplicative source)
rows.semantics: the +1% multiplicative step bumps the whole Final Damage bucket, including the live Divine Shield / Guardian / Divine Blessing / Greater Vessel share (Current / New include it)

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Weapon Acceleration's (Attack Speed), Physical Training's (Basic Attack Damage) and Weapon Mastery's (Min Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Parashock Guard's Attack% level delta (and Combat Orders' own skill-level bonus moves every 3rd-job factor)

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Paladin Expert's (Skill Damage, Max Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Weapon Acceleration, Physical Training, Weapon Mastery, Parashock Guard, Paladin Expert)

rows.label: Skill Cooldown Decrease (seconds)
rows.semantics: Combat Orders' uptime moves with the cooldown, and with it the skill-level factor of Parashock Guard / Paladin Expert (block F minus the main sheet's F)

rows.label: Buff Duration Increase %
rows.semantics: Combat Orders' uptime moves with the duration, and with it the skill-level factor of Parashock Guard / Paladin Expert (block F minus the main sheet's F)

rows.label: Pig's Ribbon
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

rows.label: Mushmom's Cap
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (Accuracy vs Evasion not modelled)

rows.label: Lunar Dew
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

cdr.note: step function in fixed-duration content (exact cast counts); fixed-duration content only
